classifications.rationale: The President describes proposed legislation and offers a hortatory appeal to private labor and management; any legal consequences would arise only if Congress enacts the proposals, not from this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I urge the private sector--labor and management alike--to follow this example and minimize wage and price increases.

classifications.rationale: This is a request that Congress consider and enact proposed legislation, not presidential governance of agencies or a provision independently changing legal rights.
classifications.evidence: I hope the Congress will consider these proposals and act on them promptly and favorably.
